literal_meaning: To make the mouth bad (word-by-word: mouth + bad + to do)
figurative_meaning_en: To use obscene or foul language
example_sentences_in_bangla: ভদ্রভাবে কথা বলো, মুখ খারাপ করো না।
সভায় মুখ খারাপ করা উচিত নয়।
example_sentences_in_english: Speak politely, don't use foul language.
It's not appropriate to swear in a meeting.
note: This idiom emphasizes politeness and restraint in Bengali verbal culture.
